overview: Based on the published agenda, the Village of Rothschild Board was scheduled to meet to consider multiple matters including policies for social media, trail maintenance agreements, library contracts, and personnel hiring for the Department of Public Works, along with a closed session discussion regarding litigation strategy related to a development agreement.
presiding: Elizabeth Felkner, Presiding Officer or Designee

discussions.item: Consideration of Motion to Adjourn to Closed Session Regarding Development Agreement with Brian Luedtke Properties, LLC
discussions.body: The Board was scheduled to convene in closed session to confer with legal counsel regarding litigation strategy related to a development agreement with Brian Luedtke Properties, LLC. The Board was expected to reconvene in open session and take action regarding matters discussed in the closed session.

discussions.item: Discussion and Possible Action Regarding Policies Pertaining to the Rothschild Radar Facebook Page
discussions.body: The Board was set to discuss and potentially take action on policies governing the Village's Rothschild Radar Facebook page. This item was scheduled for consideration and possible adoption of new or revised social media policies.

discussions.item: Discussion and Possible Action Regarding CWOCC Trail Maintenance Agreement for the 2026-2027 Winter Season
discussions.body: The Board was scheduled to discuss and potentially act on a trail maintenance agreement with CWOCC for the upcoming 2026-2027 winter season. The Board was expected to consider whether to enter into or renew this agreement for winter trail maintenance services.

discussions.item: Discussion and Possible Action Regarding Marathon County Library Contract for 2027 through 2031
discussions.body: The Board was set to review and potentially approve a multi-year library services contract with Marathon County covering the period from 2027 through 2031. This was scheduled for consideration of the Village's library service agreements and funding commitments.

discussions.item: Discussion and Possible Action Regarding Dolly Parton's Imagination Library of Marathon County Board
discussions.body: The Board was scheduled to discuss and potentially take action regarding the Village's participation or involvement with Dolly Parton's Imagination Library program in Marathon County. The nature and scope of this discussion was set for Board consideration.

discussions.item: Consideration of Motion to Adjourn to Closed Session Regarding Department of Public Works Hiring
discussions.body: The Board was scheduled to convene in closed session to discuss employment and hiring matters related to a vacant Department of Public Works position, including potential compensation, promotion, or performance evaluation considerations. The Board was expected to reconvene in open session and take action regarding matters discussed in the closed session.

publicComment: Public comment was scheduled during Requests and Statements from the Audience, limited to 3 minutes per person, with no action to be taken during public comments per open meeting law requirements.
